name: Send this to your person
title: “I'd wait for you.”
note: photo 2 redrawn once (first draw copied photo 1's pose)
caption:
For the one you would wait for. Send it to them.

Love that is real makes long seasons feel short. Jacob waited seven years, and it felt like a few days because of who he was waiting for.

Genesis 29:20 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
